tasks.title: Campaign authority schema v3: local-first registration
tasks.goal: Bump CampaignRegistrationV2 (crates/tally-core/src/campaign_registry.rs 30-56) to v3: drop issue_url, issue_number, sub_issue_walk, last_forge_observation, allow_test_local_forge; add the worklist pattern, the code repository coordinate, and the local operator actor recorded at arm time and re-checked on every verb. Move the N/N-1 compatibility tests with the schema; the pre-v3 refusal message names the remedy: disarm and re-arm. Depends on Chapter 1's drop-polluted-v2-migration having landed. Finding F4 made the defect concrete: on the current pin, tally campaign arm takes a GitHub issue URL as a required positional even under --allow-test-local-forge. The sound fix is that arm's authority input becomes the campaign identity (repository plus committed worklist path at the fetched base revision); the forge issue, where one exists, is derived from projection state. A synthetic or faked URL is never an accepted input in any mode.
deliveredBehaviors: A campaign arms with no issue coordinates
Arm-time local actor identity replaces gh-resolved identity

acceptanceCriteria.description: The v3 authority record carries no issue_url or issue_number.
tally-core test suite passes including the v2-to-v3 refusal test.

tasks.title: The module renders forge as a declared option, not a hardcode
tasks.goal: renderCampaignRepositories hardcodes forge = "github" (nix/modules/common.nix 3619, finding F10), so a module-declared campaign cannot be forge:"local" no matter what the CLI supports. Add a per-campaign forge option ("github" | "local", default "github") rendered into the registration verbatim, with a module assertion that a local-forge campaign declares no forge-native-only fields. This is the declaration-side half of authority v3: after it, the Chapter-1-style module declaration expresses the silent factory without a hand-edited registration.
deliveredBehaviors: A module-declared campaign can state forge = "local" and have it rendered into the registration
renderCampaignRepositories carries no hardcoded forge value

acceptanceCriteria.description: The renderCampaignRepositories body no longer contains a hardcoded forge literal; the value flows from the campaign option.
The flake's module assertion tests pass with the new option exercised in both values.

tasks.title: Delete the gitAi config surface; stale host keys fail loud
tasks.goal: The gate removals leave a dead config surface behind (finding F6: the deployed host still carries gitAi { enable = true } feeding a checkpoint pipeline that mints empty notes). Delete GitAiConfig and its wiring from crates/tally-core/src/config.rs (default fn at 44, serde default at 63, field at 542, Default impl at 568, validation at 625 and 695, tests at 959-961) and any nix module option that renders a gitAi key. With the key gone, config decode rejects it as unknown, so a stale host config fails loud at the deploy that ships this change - the residue is impossible to carry silently. The host-side cleanup (dropping the key from ~/.config/tally/config.json) is a documented step of that deploy, not code.
deliveredBehaviors: No gitAi symbol survives in config code or module options
A config carrying the old gitAi key is refused at boot with a clear unknown-key error

acceptanceCriteria.description: No gitAi/git_ai reference survives in the config module or the nix module tree.
tally-core suite passes including the unknown-key refusal for a legacy gitAi config.
